# Security Policy

Use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting for confidential Packmon
vulnerability reports when it is available for this repository.

This repository intentionally does not publish a universal fallback mailbox,
form URL, PGP key, or encrypted reporting destination. Private forks, mirrors,
packaged distributions, and internal deployments must provide their own
confidential security contact through the owning organization's disclosure
process.

Do not file public issues, pull requests, or discussions with exploit details,
private package names, credentials, logs, internal URLs, or personal data.

The detailed reporting process, supported versions, response expectations,
remediation targets, security update channel, good-faith research language,
and regulatory owner notes are maintained in the root `SECURITY.md`.

Security updates are published through GitHub Security Advisories, private
advisories during coordinated disclosure, and release notes. Operators should
watch repository releases and subscribe to repository security advisories for
Packmon deployments and mirrors.
